correctness.rationale: Analytic quadratic expansion and double-return cancellation checked against exact derivatives; a positive invariant cone follows from a-kappa=cs>0; the reciprocal y law and the noninteger rate are proved by a convergent weighted variation-of-constants series for 1<p<2. Uniform small-data bounds establish nonzero amplitudes on two open sets. Reproduced actual checker confirms symbolic identities and finite diagnostics without treating numerics as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Full-text comparison with the exact-model Niu–Wang primary paper shows that the 1:-1 double-neutral predator-free parameter equality is outside its global stability and positive-equilibrium theorems. The novel statement is a constructive local invariant wedge together with the noninteger alternating exponent, not basic local bifurcation existence. Related published results concern r>2 prey-only two-cycles or different prey-growth maps. The remaining risk of unindexed equivalent work is explicit.
residual_risks: An equivalent normalization of the -1/+1 codimension-two map might appear in unindexed local-bifurcation literature.
Full texts of related Ackleh works were not obtained; the model-type distinction is supported by the primary 2024 paper and publisher summaries, not by reading every theorem in those works.
The originality assessment is not independent peer review.

value.rationale: At simultaneous independent boundary bifurcations the three observable scales (inverse-time predator, inverse-time prey shift, and noninteger alternating prey correction) are a structural regime missed by stability eigenvalues. The rate p varies continuously with biological survival and saturation parameters and is genuinely attained on open sets; no global conclusion is overstated.
